visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with two young women, one with blonde bangs and a pink hoodie (main creator) and another with brown hair in a black t-shirt, standing in front of a brightly lit storefront. They wave at the camera while pink heart overlays frame their faces. The background features a glass-walled shop with numerous photo strips displayed on the glass. (2) Inside the shop, the camera focuses on a large binder filled with colorful sticker designs. The main creator's hands, with patterned nail art, flip through pages showing various cartoon-themed and Y2K-style photo frames. The lighting is bright and even studio-style lighting. (3) The main creator is seen holding a pair of large silver headphones as a prop. She puts them on while standing in a booth with a pink and blue curtain background. A computer screen with a photo interface is visible to her right. (4) Close-up on the digital interface of a photo sticker machine. The screen shows a selection of six different Y2K-themed frame options, including motifs like Yakult bottles, old mobile phones, and cherries. A purple numerical keypad is displayed on the screen. (5) The two women are inside the booth, posing for a shot. They use their hands to make heart shapes against their cheeks. The background is a simple solid blue curtain. (6) A series of quick cuts displays the finished photo products on the machine's screen. The designs are vibrant and eccentric, featuring fake 'Beauty Certificates' and vegetable-themed frames with their faces centered in a cabbage. (7) A hand holds several small, precut photo stickers of various shapes and sizes. Then, the camera shows a tiny, iridescent mini photo album being opened to reveal small portraits of the two women. The setting appears to be the interior of the shop with soft lighting. (8) The camera captures a close-up of a manual button-pressing machine. A hand pulls down a silver lever to press a circular pin badge. The resulting badges, featuring the women's faces in cabbage frames, are then shown being held up. (9) The final scene shows the two women back together, waving at the camera and holding up their finished keychains and pins. They are smiling broadly in front of the photo-covered shop window.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 台北東區復古拍貼！. [Logo]: PICKMYCCD. [Variety]: 年輕人都來這. (2) [Subtitle]: 年輕人聚集地, 來到一間復古拍貼, 瞬間覺得自己變young了. [Variety]: 好Young~~. (3) [Subtitle]: 我原本以為只是純拍貼, 沒想到這邊還能做鑰匙圈!!. (4) [Slogan]: 價格表, 拍照$200, 鑰匙圈套餐$600. (5) [Subtitle]: 排隊等待的同時, 可以先選拍照的框跟背景. (6) [Subtitle]: 有超多款式, 整個選擇困難. (7) [Subtitle]: 很難選的話這邊有分類熱門的相框, 可以直接從這邊挑比較快. (8) [Subtitle]: 現場也有拍攝道具跟小配件可使用. (9) [Subtitle]: 接著就換我們拍照啦, 現場的工作人員也會耐心的協助操作. (10) [Subtitle]: 挑了很多很Y2K可愛到不行的相框, 採自助拍攝, 開始大拍特拍. (11) [Subtitle]: 這是我拍過最多相框可選的拍貼. (12) [Subtitle]: 也有很多很ㄎ一ㄤ的, 真的是越怪越可愛. [Variety]: 越怪越可愛. (13) [Subtitle]: 展示一下我們選的相框. (14) [Subtitle]: 大拍一波後就可以洗出照片啦. (15) [Subtitle]: 因為它很小張, 我們發現現場居然有賣迷你相簿!!. (16) [Subtitle]: 馬上買來裝照片, 真的可愛瘋. [Variety]: 可愛瘋!!!. (17) [Subtitle]: 拿來放小拍貼就不擔心弄丟. (18) [Subtitle]: 重點是它還可以掛在包包上, 超有紀念價值. (19) [Subtitle]: 另外做成鑰匙圈也很有懷舊的感覺, 真的超喜歡. (20) [Subtitle]: 阿因為覺得太好玩, 我們又拍了個人的. (21) [Subtitle]: 不止可以做成鑰匙圈, 它還能做成別針. (22) [Subtitle]: 建議拍很近的大頭照, 這樣做別針會比較可愛哦. (23) [Subtitle]: 它還有很多搞怪的拍照框, 我們真的拍到意猶未盡. (24) [Slogan]: 戰利品展示. (25) [Subtitle]: 標記你的姐妹們或另外一半, 一起來拍照留念吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice introduces the 'young' atmosphere of the shop. Upbeat electronic music with a strong synth bassline starts immediately. The vocal pitch is high and enthusiastic. (2) A subtle whoosh sound effect transitions the narrator as she mentions the price list and the surprise of the keychain set. The BGM remains steady at 128 BPM. (3) The narrator's speech rate increases as she describes the process of picking backgrounds. The music maintains a constant major-mode electronic feel with synthetic percussion. (4) A metallic mechanical click is heard as the machine is mentioned. The narrator expresses excitement through high pitch variability and rising intonations. (5) Fast cuts in the visual are reflected in the quick, successive phrases of the narrator describing the various Y2K frame styles. The BGM continues without pause. (6) The vocal tone becomes even more animated, using words like 'cute' with elongated vowels. Soft pop sound effects accentuate the display of the mini-albums. (7) A percussive thud/click sound occurs during the button-pressing segment. The narrator provides a tip for better photos. (8) The final phase concludes with a warm and friendly call to action. The music reaches its final loop and fades out quickly at the end.
